title: Add real coverage for FB-3 self-echo (hasPendingWrites) filtering and implement the missing isFromCache guard in FirestoreGatewayImpl listeners
area: core/sync — FirestoreGatewayImpl listener methods (gap surfaced via firestore_gateway_impl_test.dart group 7/16)

evidence.quote: Mergers skip LWW resolution for snapshots with `metadata.hasPendingWrites` or `metadata.isFromCache`

// document's change carries `hasPendingWrites == true`. Re-processing that
    // self-write would loop the merge pipeline.

why: This is the app's anti-self-echo mechanism — the source comment says re-processing a local write's own echo 'would loop the merge pipeline.' It's implemented at 4 call sites in firestore_gateway_impl.dart but firestore_gateway_impl_test.dart's group 7/16 (listenToCollection/listenToChildCollection/listenToTutorGrants) contain zero tests of it, and repo-wide grep confirms no other test file covers it either. Worse, it's structurally impossible to test with this suite's own fixture: fake_cloud_firestore's MockSnapshotMetadata hardcodes `hasPendingWrites => false` unconditionally, so no test built on createFakeFirestore() can ever observe the filter working. Separately, isFromCache — the other half of FB-3 — does not appear anywhere in lib/ (grep returns zero hits): it is simply not implemented, so a snapshot served from local cache on listener reattach is never distinguished from a fresh server-confirmed one.
recommendation: Build a small hand-written fake implementing the cloud_firestore DocumentChange/DocumentSnapshot/SnapshotMetadata interfaces directly (per TQ-4, bypassing fake_cloud_firestore) so hasPendingWrites/isFromCache can be set true in a unit test; add the equivalent isFromCache skip-check at the four hasPendingWrites call sites in firestore_gateway_impl.dart, with a test proving a cached, non-pending snapshot doesn't get treated as authoritative.
acceptance_criteria: New test in firestore_gateway_impl_test.dart drives a hand-rolled fake DocumentChange with hasPendingWrites=true through listenToCollection and asserts the row is excluded from ListenerSnapshot.rows
firestore_gateway_impl.dart adds an isFromCache check at the four hasPendingWrites call sites (or a documented reason it's unnecessary) with a matching test
grep for isFromCache in lib/core/sync/ returns a non-zero count after the fix

corrections: None needed — all file:line citations and quotes check out exactly as claimed.
